results.title: The Exit State
results.overview: In the not-too-distant future, a group of American citizens attempt to flee the country to escape an authoritarian regime, but their path to freedom quickly becomes a dystopian nightmare.

results.title: NieR:Orchestra Concert 12026 [YoRHa]
results.overview: A new multimedia NieR orchestral production featuring full orchestra, chorus, vocalists Emi Evans and J’Nique Nicole, giant-screen visuals and a narrated story connected to the Pearl Harbor Descent Operation.

results.title: Martha
results.overview: The film explores the life of the legendary pianist Martha Argerich, following her over nearly a decade and documenting her music, memories, friendships, past loves, and travels. Drawing on memories and concert archives, the documentary reveals this one-of-a-kind performer through the eyes of her daughter, Annie Dutoit-Argerich. Together with director Martin Mirabel, they explore key events in Martha's career, allowing viewers to discover intimate, unforgettable and never-before-seen moments.

results.title: Eva
results.overview: On a romantic journey through isolated landscapes, a couple discovers that the most unsettling danger may arise from what they choose to hide or reveal.

results.title: Dolioo
results.overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

results.title: An Mor: Where the Tides Speak
results.original_title: An Mor: Where the Tides Speak
results.overview: Set along the rugged and awe-inspiring Cornish coastline, the film follows a young Zennor-born surfer and wild swimmer as she turns to the ocean and land to navigate a deeply personal crossroads.

results.title: Frank and Percy
results.overview: During their dog walks on Hampstead Heath, two older gentlemen find their conversations about everyday aches and weather growing into an unexpected connection.

results.title: Anima of dawn
results.overview: Deep within the Albariscope, an underground labyrinth ruled by darkness and machines, two unlikely companions must learn to trust one another as they face danger and search for a path toward the light.

results.title: Let's Have Kids!
results.overview: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

results.title: Bunker Heights
results.overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

results.title: Street Fighter
results.overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

results.title: Arachnado 2: Flaming Spiders
results.overview: Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, the Arachnado has returned, this time as a "Firenado" with Flaming Spiders. It's up to a renegade Sergeant Preston and the Janitor from the original film to overthrow the corrupt Lieutenant Gallagher and put the fire out.

results.title: Felt Me
results.overview: A short animated documentary exploring how queer women have been excluded from and misrepresented by mainstream media, and how they navigate and respond to that experience.

results.title: The Interned
results.overview: During an office Halloween party, an intern accidentally unleashes a demon that possesses her coworkers, forcing her to fight for survival - and a shot at a full time job.

results.title: The Garden
results.overview: A man pauses at the edge of a garden, where small, ordinary moments reveal an enchanted world at peace. Scored to the “Intermezzo” from “Cavalleria rusticana” by Pietro Mascagni, the film becomes an intermezzo of its own – a brief and somewhat unfashionable pause in an otherwise busy world.

results.title: ROBO-FRIEND
results.overview: Comedy skit about a new instalment of artificial intelligent robot pets.

results.title: A Guerra à Santa
results.overview: Why does a Saint provoke such hatred in those who seek to rule the country?  For many people, Our Lady of Aparecida is the patroness of Brazil—the mother of Jesus.  Yet, Bishop JB Carvalho has labeled Aparecida the “right-hand woman of Satan” and called for her to be stripped of her status as Brazil’s patroness. It was in his very church that Flávio Bolsonaro chose to be baptized. Among so many pastors, why surround oneself with someone who spreads hatred against people’s faith?

results.title: Being Muslim After 9/11
results.overview: Twenty-five years after 9/11, film-makers Mobeen and Masood revisit their archive and reconnect with people across the British Muslim community to explore how life has changed.

results.title: I am Destroying my Dignity and Identity
results.original_title: I am Destroying my Dignity and Identity
results.overview: Fed up with his friend being made fun of, a teenage boy defends his friend and his own honor.
